# `aube diag compare`

- **Usage:** `aube diag compare [--min-delta-ms <MIN_DELTA_MS>] [--min-pct <MIN_PCT>] <A> <B>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Diff two diag JSONL traces and surface per-operation regressions.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube diag compare baseline.jsonl current.jsonl
```

Read the [workflow guide](/troubleshooting) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<A>`** — Baseline trace
- **`<B>`** — Comparison trace

## Flags

- **`--min-delta-ms <MIN_DELTA_MS>`** — Minimum |Δsum_ms| to surface (default 50)

  **Default:** `50`
- **`--min-pct <MIN_PCT>`** — Minimum |%change| to surface (default 10)

  **Default:** `10`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
